questions: Historians generally date this current period of human history from around 1500, though many now reserve its label for events from the 19th century onward, like the Industrial Revolution — what span of time is this?
Modern era: Current period of history. Since the 1990s, it has been more common among historians to refer to the period after the Middle Ages and up to the 19th century as the early modern period.
